B1L11-G01-P247.title: Complete the following dialogues using 了.

scene.alt: A hand holding a movie ticket labelled 電影票.

repairs.note: 沒買 says it didn’t happen, but the ticket is already in hand: 買了.
不買 means “won’t buy”; the ticket is already in hand, so it’s done: 買了.
B is answering, not asking: a done action ends in 了, not 嗎.

items.fallbackRepair: 了 comes right after the verb: 我買了.

result.traditional: 我買了。
result.simplified: 我买了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le.
result.english: I bought it.

scene.alt: A full bowl of beef noodle soup beside an empty bowl.

segments.traditional: 這家店的牛肉麵真好吃，我
segments.simplified: 这家店的牛肉面真好吃，我

repairs.note: Only one bowl is empty; the other is still full: 一碗.
沒 says it didn’t happen, but the empty bowl shows it did: 吃了.
不吃 means “won’t eat”; the empty bowl shows it’s done: 吃了.
With an amount, 了 sits right after the verb, not at the end: 吃了一碗.

items.fallbackRepair: 了 goes right after the verb, before the amount: 吃了一碗.

result.traditional: 這家店的牛肉麵真好吃，我吃了一碗，還想再吃。
result.simplified: 这家店的牛肉面真好吃，我吃了一碗，还想再吃。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de niúròu miàn zhēn hǎochī, wǒ chī le yì wǎn, hái xiǎng zài chī.
result.english: The beef noodle soup at this shop is really good; I ate one bowl and want more.

segments.traditional: 老師要我們寫十個句子，我已經
segments.simplified: 老师要我们写十个句子，我已经

repairs.note: Three are still to write, so not all ten are done: ten minus three is 七個.
三個 are the ones still to write; ten minus three is 七個 done.

items.fallbackRepair: Still going, so double 了: 已經 + verb + 了 + amount + 了: 已經寫了七個了.

result.traditional: 老師要我們寫十個句子，我已經寫了七個了，還要寫三個。
result.simplified: 老师要我们写十个句子，我已经写了七个了，还要写三个。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào wǒmen xiě shí ge jùzi, wǒ yǐjīng xiě le qī ge le, hái yào xiě sān ge.
result.english: The teacher wants us to write ten sentences; I’ve already written seven, and I still have three to go.

scene.alt: A child in a school hat and backpack walking toward a small dog.

repairs.note: A dog takes the measure word 隻: 一隻狗.
The picture shows her looking at the dog, so it happened: 看到了.

items.fallbackRepair: 了 goes right after 看到, then the amount and the thing: 看到了一隻狗.

result.traditional: 妹妹昨天在路上看到了一隻狗。
result.simplified: 妹妹昨天在路上看到了一只狗。
result.pinyin: Mèimei zuótiān zài lù shàng kàndào le yì zhī gǒu.
result.english: My younger sister saw a dog on the street yesterday.

segments.traditional: 我今天要去五個地方，上午已經
segments.simplified: 我今天要去五个地方，上午已经

segments.traditional: 地方，下午還要去郵局跟超級市場。
segments.simplified: 地方，下午还要去邮局跟超级市场。

repairs.note: Two places, the post office and the supermarket, are left for the afternoon, so the morning had 三個.
Five is the whole day; two are still left for the afternoon: 三個.
已經 says the morning visits are done: 去了, not 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: 了 comes right after 去, then the amount: 去了三個地方.

result.traditional: 我今天要去五個地方，上午已經去了三個地方，下午還要去郵局跟超級市場。
result.simplified: 我今天要去五个地方，上午已经去了三个地方，下午还要去邮局跟超级市场。
result.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào qù wǔ ge dìfāng, shàngwǔ yǐjīng qù le sān ge dìfāng, xiàwǔ hái yào qù yóujú gēn chāojí shìchǎng.
result.english: I have five places to go today; I already went to three this morning, and this afternoon I still have to go to the post office and the supermarket.

B1L11-G02-P249.title: Choose 沒, 沒有 or 還沒 to fill in the blanks below.

repairs.note: A question about a done action ends 了沒 or 了沒有; 還沒 starts an answer.
A question about a done action ends 了沒 or 了沒有, never 了不.
還沒 means “not yet, but it will happen”; yesterday’s class is over, so just 沒.
不來 means “won’t come”; for yesterday’s class say 沒來.

B1L11-G04-P257.title: Complete the sentences with 先……，等……，再……。

scene.alt: Stacked bowls, an arrow, and hands washing a bowl at a sink.

repairs.note: 在 means “at” or “-ing”; “not until then” is 再: 明天再洗.
先 means “first”; the bowls wait until tomorrow: 明天再洗.

segments.traditional: 百貨公司休息了，我們明天
